multi_entity_note: ArTara, the University of Iowa (and its Research Foundation), with Chugai and the Principal Investigator named.
processing_note: ArTara will add all applicable wire transfer fees to wire transfer payments.

contract.document_name.rationale: The heading and preamble name the contract "Sponsored Research and License Agreement", and the payment reference repeats the name.

contract.agreement_date.rationale: The agreement is "entered into on November 28, 2018", and the payment reference repeats the date; 1/10/2020 is the filing footer.

contract.effective_date.rationale: November 28, 2018 is defined as the "Effective Date"; the later mention is the agreement date inside a payment reference.

contract.expiration_date.rationale: The agreement states no term or expiry date; ten years from the Effective Date is only a data-retention period.

contract.governing_law.rationale: Section 9.4 says the agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Iowa; the other Iowa mentions are names and addresses.

contract.renewal_term.rationale: The agreement has no renewal provision.

contract.notice_period.rationale: There is no renewal, so there is no notice period to prevent it; the 30-day periods are termination notices.
